accepted.name: evidence_core_attributes
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "id" AS id,
  "datasourceId" AS datasource_id,
  "datatypeId" AS datatype_id,
  "targetId" AS target_id,
  "diseaseId" AS disease_id,
  "drugId" AS drug_id,
  "score" AS score,
  "resourceScore" AS resource_score,
  "pValueMantissa" AS pvalue_mantissa,
  "pValueExponent" AS pvalue_exponent,
  "beta" AS beta,
  "oddsRatio" AS odds_ratio,
  "publicationYear" AS publication_year,
  "studyId" AS study_id,
  "releaseDate" AS release_date,
  "releaseVersion" AS release_version,
  "publicationFirstAuthor" AS publication_first_author,
  "targetFromSourceId" AS target_from_source_id,
  "diseaseFromSourceId" AS disease_from_source_id,
  "variantId" AS variant_id,
  "variantRsId" AS variant_rs_id,
  "urls" AS urls,
  "literature" AS literature
FROM OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1.PLATFORM.EVIDENCE
accepted.description: Normalized projection of EVIDENCE with stable commonly-used identifiers and key numeric measures. Use this to join evidence to targets/diseases/molecules and to compute aggregate statistics. | Use for: Aggregate evidence counts/scores by target or disease; Join evidence to target or disease metadata; Filter evidences by datasource/datatype/year/publication; Compute summary statistics (mean score, median p-value) on evidence

accepted.name: evidence_top_per_target_by_score
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  datasource_id,
  datatype_id,
  target_id,
  disease_id,
  score,
  resource_score,
  publication_year,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY target_id ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_by_score
FROM (
  SELECT
    "id" AS id,
    "datasourceId" AS datasource_id,
    "datatypeId" AS datatype_id,
    "targetId" AS target_id,
    "diseaseId" AS disease_id,
    "score" AS score,
    "resourceScore" AS resource_score,
    "publicationYear" AS publication_year
  FROM OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1.PLATFORM.EVIDENCE
) base
grain: id (one row per evidence) with rank within each target_id
accepted.description: Rank evidences per target by score descending. Exposes rank so downstream queries can select top-N evidences per target. Useful for selecting the strongest evidence items per target. | Use for: Get top-N evidence items per target; Filter strongest evidence linked to a target for downstream inspection; Combine top evidence with other aggregations per target

accepted.name: target_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "id" AS id,
  "approvedSymbol" AS approved_symbol,
  "approvedName" AS approved_name,
  "biotype" AS biotype,
  "targetClass" AS target_class,
  "synonyms" AS synonyms,
  "go" AS go,
  "pathways" AS pathways,
  "tractability" AS tractability,
  "safetyLiabilities" AS safety_liabilities
FROM OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1.PLATFORM.TARGETS
accepted.description: Clean projection of TARGETS table exposing stable identifiers and common descriptive attributes for joins and display. | Use for: Lookup target metadata by id or symbol; Join target attributes to evidence/associations; Filter targets by biotype, pathway membership or tractability flags

accepted.name: disease_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "id" AS id,
  "name" AS name,
  "code" AS code,
  "description" AS description,
  "parents" AS parents,
  "ancestors" AS ancestors,
  "descendants" AS descendants,
  "therapeuticAreas" AS therapeutic_areas
FROM OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1.PLATFORM.DISEASES
accepted.description: Projection of DISEASES exposing id, name, code and hierarchical fields for joins and hierarchical analyses. | Use for: Resolve disease name/metadata for associations; Compute disease family rollups using ancestors/parents; Filter diseases by therapeutic area

accepted.name: assoc_overall_direct_scored
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "diseaseId" AS disease_id,
  "targetId" AS target_id,
  "score" AS score,
  "evidenceCount" AS evidence_count
FROM OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1.PLATFORM.ASSOCIATIONBYOVERALLDIRECT
grain: disease_id, target_id (one row per direct association)
accepted.description: Association summary from ASSOCIATIONBYOVERALLDIRECT exposing disease-target score and evidence count. Use as the primary table for disease-target direct association queries and joins to target/disease metadata. | Use for: Rank targets by association score for a disease; Filter associations by evidence_count or score thresholds; Join association scores to target/disease metadata

accepted.name: assoc_overall_indirect_scored
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "diseaseId" AS disease_id,
  "targetId" AS target_id,
  "score" AS score,

FROM OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1.PLATFORM.ASSOCIATIONBYOVERALLINDIRECT
grain: disease_id, target_id (one row per indirect association)
accepted.description: Association summary from ASSOCIATIONBYOVERALLINDIRECT exposing disease-target indirect association score and evidence count. Useful alongside direct associations to compare evidence modalities. | Use for: Compare indirect vs direct association strengths; Combine indirect evidence into composite target prioritization

accepted.name: known_drugs_by_target
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "drugId" AS drug_id,
  "targetId" AS target_id,
  "diseaseId" AS disease_id,
  "phase" AS phase,
  "status" AS status,
  "label" AS label,
  "approvedSymbol" AS approved_symbol,
  "approvedName" AS approved_name,
  "prefName" AS pref_name,
  "tradeNames" AS trade_names,
  "mechanismOfAction" AS mechanism_of_action,
  "targetName" AS target_name
FROM OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1.PLATFORM.KNOWNDRUGSAGGREGATED
grain: drug_id, target_id, disease_id (one row per aggregated known drug link)
accepted.description: Denormalized relation listing known drugs linked to targets and diseases from KNOWNDRUGSAGGREGATED. Useful for drug-target-disease queries and safety/phase filtering when combined with MOLECULE. | Use for: List drugs targeting a given gene; Find drugs for a disease targeting prioritized targets; Filter drugs by clinical trial phase or status

accepted.name: interaction_evidence_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "interactionIdentifier" AS interaction_identifier,
  "intA" AS int_a,
  "intB" AS int_b,
  "targetA" AS target_a,
  "targetB" AS target_b,
  "interactionScore" AS interaction_score,
  "evidenceScore" AS evidence_score,
  "interactionTypeShortName" AS interaction_type,
  "pubmedId" AS pubmed_id,
  "interactionResources" AS interaction_resources
FROM OPEN_TARGETS_PLATFORM_1.PLATFORM.INTERACTIONEVIDENCE
grain: interaction_identifier (one row per interaction evidence record)
accepted.description: Projection of INTERACTIONEVIDENCE exposing interacting targets, evidence identifiers and scores to support network-level queries. | Use for: Build interaction networks between targets; Filter interactions by score or evidence and join to target metadata; Identify literature supporting an interaction (pubmedId)
